title: Finite cofans solving covering sieves on a replacement stage
statement: Let X be a scheme, K a simplicial etale X-scheme, S_m a sieve on K_m for each m, and A a finite split replacement stage through n [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage]. StageSolves K S A means that for each q at most n the term A_q has a coproduct presentation indexed by Fin l, for some natural number l, such that each constituent map followed by the component of A to K belongs to S_q. The constituents are etale X-schemes; no compactness or affine condition is required of this auxiliary presentation.
